title: Collision Domain vs Broadcast Domain
description: Understand the difference between collision domains and broadcast domains.
scenario: Understand the difference between collision domains and broadcast domains.

concepts.title: Collision Domain
concepts.body: A collision domain is a network segment where packets can collide. Each switch port is its own collision domain.
concepts.code:
Hub: 1 collision domain (all ports)
Switch: 1 collision domain per port

concepts.title: Broadcast Domain
concepts.body: A broadcast domain is a group of devices that receive each other broadcast frames. All ports in a VLAN share one broadcast domain.
concepts.code:
VLAN 1: broadcast domain
VLAN 10: broadcast domain
Each VLAN = separate broadcast domain

concepts.title: Switch vs Hub
concepts.body: A switch creates a separate collision domain per port but shares broadcast domains per VLAN. A hub shares both.
concepts.code:
Hub:  shared collision + broadcast domain
Switch: separate collision, shared broadcast per VLAN
